halsning.efter_runor: The runes heed you now. The fire burns hotter when they wake.
halsning.default: Stay close to the fire, child. The dark is listening.

bark.default: The fire is small but stubborn.

avsked.default: Go carefully. I will keep watch.

halsning.by_rensad: The village breathes easier. Pass, but keep your eyes open.
halsning.default: No one passes without leave. Not even you.

bark.default: Stand still if you wish to talk.

halsning.efter_boss: You survived the Bone King. Let me see if anything broke inside as well.
halsning.default: Sit. I will tend your wounds before they tend to you.

bark.default: I have bandages if you need them.

halsning.boss_levande: The Bone King wakes in the chapel. The graves tremble at his steps.
halsning.default: The graves grow restless at night. I keep them still.

halsning.hojd_rep: For friends of the village, better prices. Almost.
halsning.default: Everything has a price. Sometimes two.

bark.default: New goods in the basket today!

halsning.runor: Runes and steel hold better than rumors. What do you need?
halsning.default: Steel must hold. People too, if they are allowed.

bark.default: Hear that? Like iron on stone.

halsning.rykte: Folk whisper about you at the tables. Drink. It won't quiet rumors, but it helps.
halsning.default: The warmth is faint but honest. Drink before you go.

rykte.hjaltar: They say you've already done more than the whole guard together.

bark.default: Open as long as the wood lasts.

halsning.boss_dod: The Bone King fell silent. The bones in my workshop shake less now.
halsning.default: Bones tell truths people do not want to hear.

halsning.quest_aktiv: You are on the cleansing. Hold the line toward the chapel.
halsning.by_besatt: The village holds, but thinner each night. We need you out there.
halsning.default: The guards remain even when hope flees.

quest.rensningen: Clear the way to the chapel. Report when the Bone King falls.
